method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied (the principal) with a second seat for the attorney, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING or a 'not covered' constructor with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); the rules in one module, the dates in another, the questions in two seat modules importing them; two regulative rules (ss 79, 133) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seats: the principal: the person who makes, or has made, an enduring power of attorney, typically an injured person whose injury may take away or has taken away their decision making capacity and whose claim, damages or compensation an attorney may run, settle, receive and manage (poa-seat.l4)
the attorney: typically a family member appointed under the injured person's enduring power of attorney, who bears the Act's duties and liabilities (poa-seat-attorney.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run poa-dates.l4 ; l4 run poa-rules.l4 ; l4 run poa-seat.l4 ; l4 run poa-seat-attorney.l4 ; l4 run poa-cases.l4 ; l4 run poa-cases-attorney.l4
checks.result: 313 assertions written, 313 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text. poa-cases-attorney.l4 holds the mirror cases (the same facts from both seats).
